# Data Overview (all measures)
This section looks at the data overall, including numerical summaries and exploratory data analysis. Individual models and plots for specific SLEs in HRS follow. 

## Table of all variables (and missingness)
```{r}
table_all
```
Individual tables (for each SLE score) are found in Output/HRS/Tables/HRS_SLE_summary_tables.xlsx

## Histograms of DNAm AL measures and SLE in HRS
```{r}
histogramz
```

## Correlation matrix of all variables
```{r, warning = F, message=F}
ggp
```


# SLE score 1
A numerical summary for SLE score 1 is found in Output/HRS/Tables/HRS_SLE_summary_tables.xlsx

## Models comparing all three DNAm measures (DNAmAL, methAL, and methALT) to SLE Score 1. 
```{r, results='asis'}
tab_model(m1, m2, m3)
```

## Plots of all three DNAm measures (DNAmAL, methAL, and methALT) to SLE Score 1. 
```{r}
sle_plots$DNAmAL_by_sle_score1 | sle_plots$methAL_by_sle_score1 | sle_plots$methALT_by_sle_score1
```
